locations.name: Gate B12
locations.description: Proceed through security and follow signs to Gate B12. Located at the end of Concourse B.

locations.name: Baggage Claim Hall
locations.description: Follow the baggage claim signs after passing through arrivals. Carousels 1-6 are available.

locations.name: Check-In Hall
locations.description: Check-in desks are located on the departure level. Self-service kiosks are also available.

locations.name: Security Checkpoint
locations.description: Security screening is located after check-in. Please have your boarding pass and ID ready.

locations.name: Ground Transportation Hub
locations.description: Taxis, buses, car rentals and the train station are accessible from the ground floor exit.

locations.name: Executive Lounge
locations.description: The Executive Lounge is located airside on Floor 2. Access requires a boarding pass and lounge membership.

locations.name: Food Court and Restaurants
locations.description: Multiple dining options are available on Floor 1 including cafes, fast food and sit-down restaurants.

locations.name: Passenger Restrooms
locations.description: Restrooms are located on every floor near the main corridors. Accessible facilities are available.
